description: Who holds a stock and how, measured across every 13F book of the newest closed quarter, beside the quarter before: conviction (filers holding it among their ten largest positions, its weight in their books), crowding (shares held by high-turnover filers and private-fund advisers as % of shares outstanding, with its percentile among stocks at least 10 filers hold), institutional ownership of the estimated free float, holder concentration (Herfindahl, largest ten holders), how long holders have held it, the holders' estimated average cost per share and the share of 13F value held at a loss, active holders' like-for-like change, top-scored managers' net buying, Schedule 13D and 13G filers on record, holder-overlap peers (operating companies whose active holders overlap most, one row per company, funds excluded), and the filers with the highest weight in it. Cost is an estimate from quarter average prices, never a filed figure.

maxHolders.description: Highest-conviction holders to list, by the stock's weight in their 13F book (default 10, clamped to 0-50)

maxPeers.description: Holder-overlap peers to list (default 10, clamped to 0-20)
